label: Web
description: Functions implementing server-side or client-side web logic, including HTTP request/response handling, REST or GraphQL APIs, web frameworks, session management, template rendering, and browser-based interactions.

label: Mobile
description: Functions written for Android or iOS applications, mobile SDKs, or cross-platform mobile frameworks, including UI rendering, device sensor access, push notifications, and mobile-specific lifecycle management.

label: Machine Learning / AI
description: Functions implementing data preprocessing, model training, evaluation, inference, or ML pipeline orchestration, including work with ML frameworks, datasets, and statistical computation.

label: Security / Cryptography
description: Functions implementing cryptographic algorithms, security protocols, authentication, authorization, vulnerability detection, or secure communication, including work with cryptographic libraries and security standards.

label: Embedded / IoT
description: Functions written for microcontrollers, embedded systems, or IoT devices, including hardware interfacing, interrupt handling, real-time scheduling, sensor/actuator control, and low-level communication protocols.

label: Infrastructure / DevOps / Cloud
description: Functions managing deployment pipelines, containerization, cloud resource provisioning, monitoring, logging, load balancing, or service orchestration, including work with cloud SDKs and DevOps tooling.

label: Desktop / Enterprise
description: Functions implementing desktop application logic, enterprise software workflows, GUI components, inter-process communication, or enterprise integration patterns, typically targeting Windows, macOS, or Linux desktop environments.

label: Game / Graphics
description: Functions implementing game logic, rendering pipelines, physics simulation, shader programming, asset management, or graphical computation, including work with game engines and graphics APIs.

label: Blockchain
description: Functions implementing smart contract logic, consensus mechanisms, transaction validation, wallet management, token operations, or peer-to-peer blockchain networking, including work with blockchain frameworks and Web3 libraries.

label: General Utility
description: Functions performing domain-agnostic operations such as string manipulation, memory management, data structure operations, arithmetic, error handling, logging, or configuration parsing, with no domain-specific logic that would indicate a more specific domain.
